en: Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a spa-town scene in a narrow valley with wooded hillsides. A richly decorated, octagonal pavilion with arched windows and ornate detailing stands in the center of a square. A river with stone embankments runs along the left side, bordered by railings and multi‑story hotels or spa buildings. People in early 20th‑century clothing stroll and sit around the square. The word "Wildbad" is handwritten in script in the lower left margin.
